20: # Database Migrations with Alembic
21: 
22: Every time data models change in `./backend/app/models.py`, generate a new Alembic revision and apply it to the PostgreSQL database[^backend-readme].
23: 
24: ## Prerequisites
25: - PostgreSQL running (via Docker Compose: `docker compose up -d db`)[^backend-readme]
26: - Working directory: `./backend`
27: 
28: ## 1. Create a Migration Revision
29: Run Alembic autogenerate from within `./backend` using `uv`:
30: 
31: ```bash
32: uv run alembic revision --autogenerate -m "Add column last_name to User model"
33: ```
34: 
35: Alembic automatically imports SQLModel schemas from `./backend/app/models.py` and creates a version script in `./backend/app/alembic/versions/`. Commit this script to Git.
36: 
37: ## 2. Apply the Migration Locally
38: Execute the migration against PostgreSQL:
39: 
40: ```bash
41: uv run alembic upgrade head
42: ```
43: 
44: ## 3. Alternative / Direct Table Creation (Optional)
45: If running without migrations in testing environments:
46: 1. Uncomment `SQLModel.metadata.create_all(engine)` in `./backend/app/core/db.py`.
47: 2. Comment out `alembic upgrade head` in `scripts/prestart.sh`.
48: 
49: See [/computations/apply_migrations.md](/computations/apply_migrations.md) for the attested computation specification.
50:
